title: The Choice of Material
subtitle: Dr. Asma & Dr. Kamal are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷

Dr. Asma has just finished her studies. Passionate, she wants to offer her patients the best restorations. But a challenge arises: which material to choose for each situation?

Between composites, glass ionomer cements, ceramics, amalgams, and adhesive systems... the choice is vast.

The wrong material, an unsuitable technique, and the restoration fails.

The durability of care, patient satisfaction, and the practice's reputation rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Asma has just finished her studies. Passionate, she wants to offer her patients the best restorations. But a challenge arises: which material to choose for each situation? She discovers the basics of dental materials: composites, GIC, adhesive systems.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal deepen their knowledge of impression materials, plasters, waxes, ceramics, and alloys. They must master the techniques for durable restorations.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal are faced with clinical choices: composite vs. GIC, ceramic vs. resin. They must select the appropriate material for each situation.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal manage complex impressions, cementations, and temporary restorations. They master the techniques for optimal results.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal become references in dental materials. They train young dentists in the selection and use of materials.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of skills in dental materials and excellence to the profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal have laid the foundations of dental materials. But the road ahead is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Impression techniques are mastered. Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal are ready to perform complex restorations.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Clinical choices are mastered. Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Advanced techniques are mastered. Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Innovation in materials has become a key skill. Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Asma and Dr. Kamal have accomplished their mission. Materials are the heart of restorative dentistry.
